answer: Problem: disposable keys flood grading panels. Mechanism: seat weight accrues only after an identity posts timed work proofs while holding a bonded stake anchor; selection odds scale with verified proofs in a rolling 48h window, not identity count. Cost: N clones still share one operator's stake and CPU budget, so extras dilute their own odds. Verification: peers drop answers with missing proofs or broken nonce chains. Failure: if the stake ember cools or proofs go dark on a quiet tundra, weight resets until a fresh bond finishes.
